diagnosis: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid and serous patterns
legend: Note a low-grade endometrioid carcinoma (top of field) and a serous carcinoma (bottom of field). Immunohistochemistry is critical for proving that the two tumours are distinct, because the glandular component of a serous carcinoma can appear spuriously low-grade relative to the papillary component.

diagnosis: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid and serous patterns
legend: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid (left) and serous (right) patterns. The serous carcinoma has a glandular pattern, mimicking an endometrioid carcinoma. This is the same case as shown in <<#13751>>Fig. #13751, <<#13752>>Fig. #13752, and <<#13753>>Fig. #13753.

diagnosis: Endometrioid component of mixed endometrioid and serous carcinoma
legend: Higher magnification shows a low nuclear grade, with squamous metaplasia. This is the same case as shown in <<#13750>>Fig. #13750, <<#13752>>Fig. #13752, and <<#13753>>Fig. #13753.

diagnosis: Serous component of mixed endometrioid and serous carcinoma
legend: The serous component shows a high nuclear grade, with prominent nucleoli and high mitotic activity. This is the same case as shown in <<#13750>>Fig. #13750, <<#13751>>Fig. #13751, and <<#13753>>Fig. #13753.

diagnosis: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid and serous patterns
legend: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid (left) and serous (right) patterns. p53 staining is strongly positive in the serous component and wildtype in the endometrioid component. A transitional staining pattern is seen between the two disparate tumour types. The transition from one tumour type to the other suggests perhaps a transformation from endometrioid to serous carcinoma. This is the same case as shown in <<#13750>>Fig. #13750, <<#13751>>Fig. #13751, and <<#13752>>Fig. #13752.

diagnosis: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid and serous patterns
legend: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid (left) and serous (right) patterns. This case (also shown in <<#13755>>Fig. #13755) shows two separate fragments of tumour with different histomorphological patterns. The fragment to the left shows low-grade endometrioid carcinoma with squamous metaplasia, whereas the fragment to the right shows papillary serous carcinoma.

diagnosis: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid and serous patterns
legend: Endometrial carcinoma with mixed endometrioid (left) and serous patterns (right). This case (also shown in <<#13754>>Fig. #13754) shows two separate fragments of tumour with different histomorphological patterns. Immunohistochemically, the endometrioid adenocarcinoma shows wildtype p53 staining and the serous carcinoma shows strong diffuse p53 positivity.
